title: Explain a Repair Request

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Aim for 90–120 seconds; this is a suggested target, not a minimum. Use at least six lesson words. To pass review, your answer’s transcript must contain at least 100 words, and the required audio and review evidence must be available. The reference and its audio are short language examples, not full-length demonstrations; create your own answer.
prompt: Describe a fictional maintenance request. Say what you noticed, what was checked before, and how you would arrange appropriate help. Aim to speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would contact the building manager about a damp patch near the kitchen sink. I would explain that a pipe was inspected last week, but the floor is still wet. The faucet also drips, so I would ask for a qualified worker to check it. I could meet the worker on Wednesday afternoon and send a photograph before the visit. I would also mention a loose cupboard handle. A carpenter could decide whether the hinge or screw needs attention. If I noticed a cable near a socket, I would leave it alone and ask the manager to contact a technician. Finally, I would write down the appointment and confirm the time.
